about_the_game:
Descend Into the Unknown

Venture deep into alien worlds in this thrilling co-op roguelike adventure. Explore procedurally generated underground caverns teeming with danger, hidden treasures, and untold secrets. Every run is different — the deeper you go, the deadlier the creatures, the rarer the resources, and the greater the rewards.

Mine, and Upgrade

Excavate valuable minerals, gather exotic materials, and trade them at your space station for powerful gear, gadgets, and tools. Customize your loadout to suit your playstyle, from heavy weaponry for direct combat to specialized equipment for exploration and survival.

Fight for Survival

Face hostile alien creatures that guard their subterranean homes with ferocity. Encounter minibosses that test your strategy and teamwork, and prepare for the ultimate challenge lurking at the core of each world. Every descent is a test of skill, coordination, and adaptability.

Team Up in Co-op

Bring your friends along for the journey. Combine your strengths, share resources, and strategize together to overcome the increasingly hazardous depths. Communication and teamwork are key — one wrong move could cost the entire team.

Replay, Discover, Conquer

No two runs are alike. Procedurally generated caves, dynamic enemy spawns, and randomized loot ensure every expedition is unique. Experiment with different strategies, adapt to unexpected threats, and aim to conquer the final boss guarding the heart of each planet.

Key Features:

  • Co-op roguelike gameplay for up to 4 players

  • Procedurally generated caves full of resources, traps, and enemies

  • Intense combat with regular foes, minibosses, and epic final bosses

  • Deep mining, crafting, and gear progression systems

  • High replayability with unique runs every time

  • Atmospheric alien worlds to explore, survive, and conquer

  • Descend together, dig deep, fight hard — and see if you have what it takes to reach the core.
